name: sdlc
description: Sixteen executor discipline skills for core SDLC tasks — detailed specialist instructions for capable models (Opus-class) acting as subagents: readiness check, task decomposition, contract design, API design, feature implementation, test design, code review, security review, refactoring, performance optimization, bug fixing, hotfix/incident response, migrations, dependency upgrades, integration, and ADRs. Each skill encodes the workflow, gates, and anti-patterns of a specialist engineer.
